trophies.name: Epilogue: War is over

ko-KR.name: 에필로그: 종전
ko-KR.description: 오랫동안 전쟁의 광풍이 미친 듯이 도처를 휩쓸었다. 너무 많은 이들이 너무 오랫동안 시달렸지. 하지만 난 살아남았다. 나만 살아남은 것이 아니기를.

en-US.name: Epilogue: War is over
en-US.description: The war ends some day. It did for me. I hope I am not the only one.

trophies.description: The war ends some day. It did for me. I hope I am not the only one.

trophies.name: Diary: Day 7

ko-KR.name: 일기: 7일
ko-KR.description: 여기에서 숨은 것이 7일째다. 도처에 죽음이 도사렸지만, 적어도 지금까진 우리 모두 살았으니 다행이지...

en-US.name: Diary: Day 7
en-US.description: It's been seven days since we holed up here. We survived for a week! So far…

trophies.description: It's been seven days since we holed up here. We survived for a week! So far…

trophies.name: Diary: Effing Snow

ko-KR.name: 일기: 빌어먹을 눈
ko-KR.description: 망할 놈의 눈. 도시가 반쯤 눈에 파묻힌 탓에 갈 수가 없다. 제설기를 기다려봐야 오지도 않을 테지...

en-US.name: Diary: Effing Snow
en-US.description: When the winter strikes Pogoren, you better be ready.

trophies.description: When the winter strikes Pogoren, you better be ready.

trophies.name: Diary: Finished ransacking

ko-KR.name: 일기: 방 정리 끝
ko-KR.description: 우린 집을 구석구석 샅샅이 뒤집어 엎었고, 이제 더는 유용한 걸 찾을 수가 없다. 밖으로 나가야 한다.

en-US.name: Diary: Finished ransacking
en-US.description: We've used every little thing we found here. We must venture outside.

trophies.description: We've used every little thing we found here. We must venture outside.

trophies.name: Note: Bless the radio

ko-KR.name: 메모: 라디오 만세
ko-KR.description: 라디오가 기대 이상으로 유용하다. 새 소식도 들을 수 있고, 일상 생활 이야기와 더 넓은 세상이 있다는 것을 떠올리게 해준다.

en-US.name: Note: Bless the radio
en-US.description: The radio is useful beyond expectations. We get the news!

trophies.description: The radio is useful beyond expectations. We get the news!

trophies.name: Note: Distilled gold

ko-KR.name: 메모: 술은 소중해
ko-KR.description: 마침내 증류법으로 밀주를 만들어냈다. 포위된 도시에서 먹거리와 술은 언제나 수요가 많지.

en-US.name: Note: Distilled gold
en-US.description: We finally managed to distill some moonshine. Always in high demand.

trophies.description: We finally managed to distill some moonshine. Always in high demand.

trophies.name: Note: Doubled the watch

ko-KR.name: 메모: 경계 태세 강화
ko-KR.description: 밤에 침입하려는 놈들한테서 우리 피신처를 지키는 게 무엇보다도 중요하다. 두 사람이 보초를 서면 도둑이 드는지 살펴보면서 서로 조심할 수 있겠지.

en-US.name: Note: Doubled the watch
en-US.description: It's crucial to secure our place against night intruders. Two may be enough.

trophies.description: It's crucial to secure our place against night intruders. Two may be enough.

trophies.name: Diary: Miraculous recovery

ko-KR.name: 일기: 기적의 회복
ko-KR.description: 심각한 중병에서 치료되다니, 약이 기적처럼 듣고 있단 사실이 증명됐다. 아니면 우리 중 몇몇은 정말 강인한 면역 체계를 갖고 있거나.

en-US.name: Diary: Miraculous recovery
en-US.description: This recovery from a grave illness proves that medicines work miracles.

trophies.description: This recovery from a grave illness proves that medicines work miracles.

trophies.name: Diary: Patched up and ready to go

ko-KR.name: 일기: 응급 처치 끝, 나갈 준비 완료
ko-KR.description: 운도 좋지, 심각한 상처에 붕대도 둘렀고 잘 낫고 있다. 누군가 우릴 위해 기도를 하나 보다.

en-US.name: Diary: Patched up and ready to go
en-US.description: What good fortune! The wounds are healing nicely.

trophies.description: What good fortune! The wounds are healing nicely.

trophies.name: Diary: Back from the brink

ko-KR.name: 일기: 구사일생
ko-KR.description: 친절한 말과 행동으로 깊은 우울증에 빠져 있던 이가 살아가도록 도왔다. 우울증이 깊으면 탄환만큼이나 치명적이기 마련이지.

en-US.name: Diary: Back from the brink
en-US.description: With just kind words and deeds, we helped one of us survive the darkest moment.

trophies.description: With just kind words and deeds, we helped one of us survive the darkest moment.

trophies.name: Diary: Hostel's open!

ko-KR.name: 일기: 호스텔 개장!
ko-KR.description: 모두가 누울 침대를 충분히 갖췄다. 정확히는 나가서 물자를 찾을 사람의 침대 하나만 빼고.

en-US.name: Diary: Hostel's open!
en-US.description: We have now enough beds for everybody.

trophies.description: We have now enough beds for everybody.

trophies.name: Diary: Shooting for five stars

ko-KR.name: 일기: 5성급 호텔
ko-KR.description: 이런 상황에 내몰린 이후 처음으로 우리 모두 따뜻한 식사를 했다. 익숙해지면 안 되는데.

en-US.name: Diary: Shooting for five stars
en-US.description: For the first time since we wound up here all of us ate a hot meal.

trophies.description: For the first time since we wound up here all of us ate a hot meal.

trophies.name: Diary: First blood

ko-KR.name: 일기: 첫 유혈 사태
ko-KR.description: 우리 중 한 명이 치명적인 죽음에 처음으로 맞섰고, 살아남았다. 이런 일이 더는 없기를 기도할 뿐이다.

en-US.name: Diary: First blood
en-US.description: One of us survived our first brush with violent death.

trophies.description: One of us survived our first brush with violent death.

trophies.name: Note: Creature comforts

ko-KR.name: 메모: 편안한 환경
ko-KR.description: 우리 은신처가 집의 모양새를 갖추기 시작했다. 상대적으로 편안한 환경에서 살 수 있도록 가구를 갖춰 보자. 사기도 오르겠지.

en-US.name: Note: Creature comforts
en-US.description: Our place is starting to resemble a proper home.

trophies.description: Our place is starting to resemble a proper home.

trophies.name: Diary: Traces of lives

ko-KR.name: 일기: 생명의 흔적
ko-KR.description: 방문하는 모든 건물마다 이야기가 깃들어 있다. 가끔 우리가 뒤에 남겨둔 이야기는 무엇일까 궁금해진다...

en-US.name: Diary: Traces of lives
en-US.description: Every building we visit has a story to tell. The more you learn, the better.

trophies.description: Every building we visit has a story to tell. The more you learn, the better.

trophies.name: Diary: We Have Wintered

ko-KR.name: 일기: 겨울을 버텨냈다
ko-KR.description: 겨울이 지나갔다. 추위가 누그러진다. 우리가 해낸 거다... 모두가 살아남았어! 기적 같다.

en-US.name: Diary: We Have Wintered
en-US.description: The winter's gone. The freeze is over. We all made it through.

trophies.description: The winter's gone. The freeze is over. We all made it through.

trophies.name: Epilogue: We made it!

ko-KR.name: 에필로그: 성공이다!
ko-KR.description: 처음에는 해낼 거라고 생각하지 않았다. 너무 많이 죽어나갔으니까. 하지만 우린 아직 살아있다. 여기에도... 뭔가 의미가 있는 거겠지?

en-US.name: Epilogue: We made it!
en-US.description: Many died, but we're all still here. This surely means something... right?

trophies.description: Many died, but we're all still here. This surely means something... right?

trophies.name: Diary: We've been everywhere

ko-KR.name: 일기: 모든 곳을 가봤다
ko-KR.description: 근처를 전부 수색했다. 점점 더 유용한 걸 찾기가 어려워진다. 이놈의 전쟁은 빨리 끝나질 않는군.

en-US.name: Diary: We've been everywhere
en-US.description: We've combed through all the neighborhood. Can we scavenge anything left?

trophies.description: We've combed through all the neighborhood. Can we scavenge anything left?

trophies.name: Diary: We Made A Stand

ko-KR.name: 일기: 맞서 싸웠다
ko-KR.description: 강도놈들이 떼를 지어서 습격했다. 마치 배가 고파서 미친 개들 같았다. 매일 밤 우린 놈들을 쫓아냈다. 그리고 모두가 살아남았다. 기적이야.

en-US.name: Diary: We Made A Stand
en-US.description: The bandits came in packs like dogs driven mad with hunger, but we were stronger.

trophies.description: The bandits came in packs like dogs driven mad with hunger, but we were stronger.

trophies.name: Note: A bit of indulgence

ko-KR.name: 메모: 약간의 사치
ko-KR.description: 처음으로 우리 모두 약간의 사치를 부려봤다. 기운이 샘솟는 느낌이다. 건강 문제는 어쩌지... 이러나 저러나 오늘밤에 죽을 수도 있는데.

en-US.name: Note: A bit of indulgence
en-US.description: Coffee and smokes - sometimes that's all.

trophies.description: Coffee and smokes - sometimes that's all.

trophies.name: Epilogue: Exodus

ko-KR.name: 에필로그: 탈출
ko-KR.description: 드디어 안전하다. 불타는 도시를 뒤돌아보며 눈물을 닦아냈다. 도시를 떠나길 바랐던 사람들이 모두 성공했기를 기도한다. 포고렌 탈출.

en-US.name: Epilogue: Exodus
en-US.description: Being forced to leave home is cruel. But when home is hell, you gotta escape.

ko-KR.description: "실적을 완벽히 제패하다니. 대단한데! 그렇지, Ryu?" "이 길의 극한에 도달했군. 진정한 격투가의 길은 지금부터가 시작이다. 하지만 지금은 달성의 기쁨을 함께 나누도록 하지."

en-US.description: "Sweet! You got all the achievements! You're really somethin'. Isn't that right, Ryu?" "You have done well to reach the end of this one journey. The path to becoming a true fighter still lies ahead, but let us take time to share the joy of your accomplishment."

trophies.name: Number 2 Is The New Number 1

ko-KR.name: 최고의 2
ko-KR.description: 니히히! 2, 20, 200! 입에 착착 감기는군요! 플레이어 레벨을 200으로 만들어 보십시오! 이 정도 위치는 되어야 저의 특등석이라 할 수 있죠!

en-US.name: Number 2 Is The New Number 1
en-US.description: Niiihehe! 2, 20, 200! Such a glorious sound, I could say it twice more! 200! Raise you player level to 200! I already have, niiihehe!

trophies.description: Niiihehe! 2, 20, 200! Such a glorious sound, I could say it twice more! 200! Raise you player level to 200! I already have, niiihehe!

trophies.name: Make A Name For Yourself

ko-KR.name: 칭호는 정말 좋아!
ko-KR.description: 칭호를 10개 모아 보지 그래? 칭호는 정말 끝내준다고! Mel도 아빠가 멋있다고 했거든!

en-US.name: Make A Name For Yourself
en-US.description: Why don't you see if you can collect 10 titles? There's nothin' like a good title! Even Mel said they make me look cool!

trophies.description: Why don't you see if you can collect 10 titles? There's nothin' like a good title! Even Mel said they make me look cool!

trophies.name: Sultan Of Titles

ko-KR.name: 칭호왕
ko-KR.description: 난 소용돌이의 Rashid! 칭호는 그때그때 기분에 따라 바꾸라고 있는 거 아니겠어? 30개나 있다면 평생 쓸 수 있지 않을까?

en-US.name: Sultan Of Titles
en-US.description: I am Rashid of the Turbulent Wind! You can change how you feel, just with a title! If you had 30 of them, you'd be set for the rest of your life!

trophies.description: I am Rashid of the Turbulent Wind! You can change how you feel, just with a title! If you had 30 of them, you'd be set for the rest of your life!

trophies.name: Fighting On The Internet

ko-KR.name: 인터넷으로 대전하는 시대!
ko-KR.description: 좋아, 네트워크 대전으로 10번 싸워 볼까? 인터넷은 내 놀이터나 다름없으니 절대 질 수 없어! (배틀 라운지는 제외)

en-US.name: Fighting On The Internet
en-US.description: Alright, time you fought 10 network battles! The Internet is like my backyard - not a place I tend to lose! (Excludes Battle Lounge)

trophies.description: Alright, time you fought 10 network battles! The Internet is like my backyard - not a place I tend to lose! (Excludes Battle Lounge)

trophies.name: All Going To Plan!

ko-KR.name: 대전은 순조롭습니다!
ko-KR.description: 네트워크 대전에서 50시합을 돌파했습니다! 뜨거운 스피릿이 맞붙는 최고의 링이었습니다! (배틀 라운지는 제외)

en-US.name: All Going To Plan!
en-US.description: Master Zangief! I fought in 50 network battles! The ring came to life with the clash of burning spirits! (Excludes Battle Lounge)

trophies.description: Master Zangief! I fought in 50 network battles! The ring came to life with the clash of burning spirits! (Excludes Battle Lounge)

trophies.name: A Fiendish Trap

ko-KR.name: 마인의 계략
ko-KR.description: 네트워크 대전에서 300시합을 했다고? 큭큭큭. 내 Psycho Power의 진수를 조만간 보여 줄 수 있겠군. (배틀 라운지는 제외)

en-US.name: A Fiendish Trap
en-US.description: Impossible! You fought in 300 network battles? Well then, the time for you to witness my Psycho Power draws near. Mwahaha! (Excludes Battle Lounge)

trophies.description: Impossible! You fought in 300 network battles? Well then, the time for you to witness my Psycho Power draws near. Mwahaha! (Excludes Battle Lounge)

trophies.name: Waiting Is Half The Fun

ko-KR.name: 기다리는 것 또한 재미
ko-KR.description: 대기 기능을 사용해서 30번의 네트워크 대전을 해 보거라. 기다리면 기다릴수록 꺾을 때의 기쁨은 커질 테니.

en-US.name: Waiting Is Half The Fun
en-US.description: Patience is key to any warrior's training. Fight in network battles 30 times using the standby function. The longer you wait, the greater the joy will be when you finally get picked.

trophies.description: Patience is key to any warrior's training. Fight in network battles 30 times using the standby function. The longer you wait, the greater the joy will be when you finally get picked.

trophies.name: I Know Kung Fu!

ko-KR.name: 이건 쿵후의 성과야!
ko-KR.description: 첫 승리 축하해! 앞으로도 랭크 매치에서 쿵후 실력을 쌓아 나가자! 당신이라면 금방 잘할 수 있을 거야!

en-US.name: I Know Kung Fu!
en-US.description: Congratulations on your first win! Keep practicing your Kung Fu in those Ranked Matches and I know you'll only get better and better!

trophies.description: Congratulations on your first win! Keep practicing your Kung Fu in those Ranked Matches and I know you'll only get better and better!

trophies.name: Addicted To Winning

ko-KR.name: 승리를 향한 집념
ko-KR.description: 랭크 매치에서 10승을 한 모양이군. 승리를 향한 집념을 항상 잊지 마라. 그러지 않으면 패배가 네 미래를 가두고 말 테니.

en-US.name: Addicted To Winning
en-US.description: It seems you've won 10 Ranked Matches. Never forget how it feels to win, or your future will soon be eclipsed by defeat.

trophies.description: It seems you've won 10 Ranked Matches. Never forget how it feels to win, or your future will soon be eclipsed by defeat.

trophies.name: Working Up An Appetite!

ko-KR.name: 밥이 맛있어질 거다!
ko-KR.description: 랭크 매치에서 30승을 하고 와라! 싸움꾼들을 잔뜩 집어던지고 난 뒤에 먹는 밥맛은 각별하거든!

en-US.name: Working Up An Appetite!
en-US.description: 30 Ranked Matches already? Lemme go catch up to that! Dinner always tastes better after you've pummeled a bunch of chumps!

trophies.description: 30 Ranked Matches already? Lemme go catch up to that! Dinner always tastes better after you've pummeled a bunch of chumps!

trophies.name: Ceaseless Effort

ko-KR.name: 끊임없는 노력
ko-KR.description: 랭크 매치에서 100승을 거둔 건가? 제법 뿌듯해 보이는군. 지금 그 감각을 잊지 말고 한 걸음씩 나아가도록.

en-US.name: Ceaseless Effort
en-US.description: Ah, your 100th Ranked Match victory. That look in your eyes tells me it was a fulfilling battle. Go forward one step at a time, and never forget this feeling.

trophies.description: Ah, your 100th Ranked Match victory. That look in your eyes tells me it was a fulfilling battle. Go forward one step at a time, and never forget this feeling.

trophies.name: Bam, Bam, Win!

ko-KR.name: 쭉쭉 이겨 나갈 거야!
ko-KR.description: 랭크 매치 300승을 통해 Matsuda류를 화끈하게 알리고 오자! Matsuda류 후계자, Laura Matsuda가 바로 여기 있다고 말이야!

en-US.name: Bam, Bam, Win!
en-US.description: Winning 300 matches will put the word out for Matsuda Jiu-Jitsu! It'll be like, "the succesor or Matsuda Jiu-Jitsu, Laura Matsuda is right here!"

trophies.description: Winning 300 matches will put the word out for Matsuda Jiu-Jitsu! It'll be like, "the succesor or Matsuda Jiu-Jitsu, Laura Matsuda is right here!"

trophies.name: Always Someone Stronger

ko-KR.name: 나보다 강한 자를 만나러 간다
ko-KR.description: 랭크 매치에서 자신보다 강한 상대와 싸워 보고 싶지 않나? 강적과의 싸움에서 얻을 수 있는 것이 존재하지. 10승을 거두고 나면 알게 될 거다.

en-US.name: Always Someone Stronger
en-US.description: Why not try fighting someone stronger than you in a Ranked Match? There's a lot you can gain from fighting stronger opponents. Beat 10 of 'em and you'll understand.

trophies.description: Why not try fighting someone stronger than you in a Ranked Match? There's a lot you can gain from fighting stronger opponents. Beat 10 of 'em and you'll understand.

trophies.name: Savoring The Win Streak

ko-KR.name: 연승의 맛
ko-KR.description: 랭크 매치에서 3연승을 했다고? 힘을 어떻게 쓰는지를 깨달은 모양이군. 아직 앞길은 많이 남았다. 안주하지 말고 수련을 계속하거라.

en-US.name: Savoring The Win Streak
en-US.description: Achieved three consecutive victories in Ranked Matches, have you? It appears you are getting a handle on your power. Maintain your modesty, and focus on your training; the path ahead is long.

trophies.description: Achieved three consecutive victories in Ranked Matches, have you? It appears you are getting a handle on your power. Maintain your modesty, and focus on your training; the path ahead is long.

trophies.name: First Promotion!

ko-KR.name: 첫 승격입니다!
ko-KR.description: 처음으로 리그 등급이 올라간 기념으로 Zangief 님께 꽃다발을 받았습니다! 눈물이 앞을 가려 카드를 읽을 수가 없군요!

en-US.name: First Promotion!
en-US.description: Master Zangief sent me flowers to celebrate me moving up a league for the first time! I can't read the card with all these tears!

trophies.description: Master Zangief sent me flowers to celebrate me moving up a league for the first time! I can't read the card with all these tears!

trophies.name: Muscles Bring Victory!

ko-KR.name: 근육의 승리!
ko-KR.description: 실버 리그로 올랐구나! 하라쇼! 네겐 재능이 있다. 앞으로 더 강해지겠지!

en-US.name: Muscles Bring Victory!
en-US.description: Did you make it to Silver League?! Horosho! You have very good muscle! You can get much stronger from now!

trophies.description: Did you make it to Silver League?! Horosho! You have very good muscle! You can get much stronger from now!

trophies.name: Let's fight someone strong!

ko-KR.name: 강한 녀석과 싸워 보자고!
ko-KR.description: 드디어 골드 리그다! 라이벌로 삼을 만한 녀석들이 많은데? 앞으로가 기대되는군!

en-US.name: Let's fight someone strong!
en-US.description: Finally, Golden League! There are so many potential rivals! Now the fun really begins!

trophies.description: Finally, Golden League! There are so many potential rivals! Now the fun really begins!

trophies.name: Go Out With A Bang

ko-KR.name: 상쾌하고 통쾌하게!
ko-KR.description: "EX 필살기로 마무리하는 건 정말 통쾌해! 그렇지, 영감님?" "드디어 주인님도 깨달으셨군요. 우선은 300번 달성을 목표로 하시겠습니까?" "뭐!? 그거 몇 년이나 걸리는 거야!?"

en-US.name: Go Out With A Bang
en-US.description: "Finishing with an EX Special Move sure feels good, old man!" "You finally understand then, young one? How about you try doing it 300 times?" "Wha?! You know how many years that'll take?!"

trophies.description: "Finishing with an EX Special Move sure feels good, old man!" "You finally understand then, young one? How about you try doing it 300 times?" "Wha?! You know how many years that'll take?!"

trophies.name: Critical Beauty

ko-KR.name: 아름답게 떨어지거라
ko-KR.description: Critical Art로 300번의 마무리라... 아무리 추한 자라도 가슴에 피는 진홍의 장미는 아름다운 법...

en-US.name: Critical Beauty
en-US.description: 300 Critical Art finishes... It would seem a crimson rose that blooms within an ugly heart can still be beautiful...

trophies.description: 300 Critical Art finishes... It would seem a crimson rose that blooms within an ugly heart can still be beautiful...

trophies.name: Not Over 'Til It's Over

ko-KR.name: 저력을 보여 주겠어!
ko-KR.description: "이대로 끝낼 수는 없어!" 이런 생각이 들면 V-Reversal이 나설 차례지. 100번쯤 연습해 보면 언제든 성공시킬 수 있게 될 거야!

en-US.name: Not Over 'Til It's Over
en-US.description: When you get that feeling like "I can't let it end like this!", that's when you should use a V-Reversal. Practice it 100 times, and then you'll be able to pull it off in your sleep!

trophies.description: When you get that feeling like "I can't let it end like this!", that's when you should use a V-Reversal. Practice it 100 times, and then you'll be able to pull it off in your sleep!

trophies.name: Enlightenment

ko-KR.name: 눈을 뜨는 진리
ko-KR.description: 그대의 몸 안에는 힘이 잠들어 있다. 그걸 알고 싶거든 V-Skill을 100회 발동시켜 보거라. 그러면 그 힘은 그대의 것이 될 터.

en-US.name: Enlightenment
en-US.description: There is a power that resides deep within you. If you wish to know what that power is, trigger a V-Skill 100 times. Do so, and that power will belong to you.

trophies.description: There is a power that resides deep within you. If you wish to know what that power is, trigger a V-Skill 100 times. Do so, and that power will belong to you.

trophies.name: Sudden Reversal

ko-KR.name: 순간의 역습
ko-KR.description: 흐름을 바꾸고 싶다면 V-Trigger가 제격이지 않을까? 100번 발동시키고 나면 틀림없이 효과를 알 수 있을 거야.

en-US.name: Sudden Reversal
en-US.description: You know, the V-Trigger is pretty handy for shifting the flow of battle. You'll know just how effective it is once you've triggered it 100 times.

trophies.description: You know, the V-Trigger is pretty handy for shifting the flow of battle. You'll know just how effective it is once you've triggered it 100 times.

trophies.name: Playing Favorites

ko-KR.name: 누구를 가장 선호하십니까?
ko-KR.description: 선호 캐릭터를 설정하십시오! 뭐라고요? 누굴 골라야 할지 망설여지십니까? 니히히히! 그럴 땐 Bison 님을 고르는 것이 정답입니다!

en-US.name: Playing Favorites
en-US.description: You must set a character as your favorite! Can't decide who to choose? Niiihehehe! Well, you can't go wrong with Lord Bison!

trophies.description: You must set a character as your favorite! Can't decide who to choose? Niiihehehe! Well, you can't go wrong with Lord Bison!

trophies.name: All In A Name

ko-KR.name: 어울리는 이름
ko-KR.description: 칭호는 알맞게 꾸며야만 비로소 빛나는 것. 자, 내게 어울리는 칭호를 고르거라.

en-US.name: All In A Name
en-US.description: You'll never stand out without an original title. Try choosing an appropriate title for me.

trophies.description: You'll never stand out without an original title. Try choosing an appropriate title for me.

trophies.name: Failing To Prepare Is Preparing To Fail

ko-KR.name: 대책은 확실하게
ko-KR.description: 리플레이를 30편 모아라. 착실히 준비하고 상대의 약점을 완벽히 파악한 자만이 승부를 지배한다. 의욕이 앞서 목숨을 잃는 일은 없도록 해야겠지.

en-US.name: Failing To Prepare Is Preparing To Fail
en-US.description: Collect 30 replays, kid. Once you've done your prep and know your opponent's weaknesses, you'll be in control of the fight. Don't risk your life by rushing in blind.

trophies.description: Collect 30 replays, kid. Once you've done your prep and know your opponent's weaknesses, you'll be in control of the fight. Don't risk your life by rushing in blind.

trophies.name: See You In My Dreams!

ko-KR.name: 꿈속에서도 만나고 싶습니다!
ko-KR.description: 이미지 트레이닝은 중요합니다! 리플레이를 50번 재생해 보십쇼! 저는 이걸로 꿈속에서도 Zangief 님을 볼 수 있게 됐습니다!

en-US.name: See You In My Dreams!
en-US.description: Visualization is a crucial skill, so try watching 50 replays! I watched so many, I started seeing Master Zangief in my dreams!

trophies.description: Visualization is a crucial skill, so try watching 50 replays! I watched so many, I started seeing Master Zangief in my dreams!

trophies.name: Not-So-Secret Admirer

ko-KR.name: 존경하는 사람
ko-KR.description: 목표로 삼는 사람이 있으면 의욕이 더욱 샘솟는 법이야! 당신도 내 리스트에 누군가를 등록해 봐.

en-US.name: Not-So-Secret Admirer
en-US.description: When someone sets their sights on you, don't you just wanna try even harder? Add someone to your Favorites and see what happens!

trophies.description: When someone sets their sights on you, don't you just wanna try even harder? Add someone to your Favorites and see what happens!

trophies.name: Global Network

ko-KR.name: 글로벌 네트워크
ko-KR.description: 제 수첩에는 세계 각국 정상의 직통 번호가 기록되어 있답니다. 당신 역시 적어도 30명 정도는 내 리스트에 등록해야 하지 않겠어요?

en-US.name: Global Network
en-US.description: I have the direct lines for all the world's leaders recorded in my pocketbook. You should have 30 names in your Favorites at the very least.

trophies.description: I have the direct lines for all the world's leaders recorded in my pocketbook. You should have 30 names in your Favorites at the very least.

trophies.name: Bodybuilding Is Life

ko-KR.name: 근육 단련이 최고입니다!
ko-KR.description: 트레이닝 모드에서 30분 동안 특훈을 해 보십쇼! "근육은 배신하지 않는다"는 말도 있지 않습니까! 에헤헤, 사실 이건 Zangief 님의 말씀입니다!

en-US.name: Bodybuilding Is Life
en-US.description: Go try out Training Mode for 30 minutes! "Bodybuilding never let man down." I borrowed that one from Master Zangief!

trophies.description: Go try out Training Mode for 30 minutes! "Bodybuilding never let man down." I borrowed that one from Master Zangief!

trophies.name: Win Or Die Tryin'

ko-KR.name: 계속 이기십시오
ko-KR.description: 서바이벌 모드를 NORMAL 코스로 클리어하십시오! 거절하면 어떻게 되는지 알고 있겠죠? 당신이 살아남으려면 계속 이기는 수밖엔 없는 겁니다!

en-US.name: Win Or Die Tryin'
en-US.description: It's about time you cleared Survival Mode on normal difficulty. You know what happens if you refuse, don't you? Let's just say the only way you live is if you keep on winning!

trophies.description: It's about time you cleared Survival Mode on normal difficulty. You know what happens if you refuse, don't you? Let's just say the only way you live is if you keep on winning!

trophies.name: A True Warrior's Spirit

ko-KR.name: 강한 전사의 혼
ko-KR.description: 전사의 혼은 서바이벌 모드에서 더욱 저...정제된다. HARD 모드를 끝까지 이겨 내면, 내가 지...집어삼키기에 알맞은 혼이라 할 수 있으리라.

en-US.name: A True Warrior's Spirit
en-US.description: A warrior's soul is ri...ripened in Survival Mode. Emerge victorious on hard difficulty and you'll be ready for me to co...consume.

trophies.description: A warrior's soul is ri...ripened in Survival Mode. Emerge victorious on hard difficulty and you'll be ready for me to co...consume.

trophies.name: Back From Hell

ko-KR.name: 지옥으로부터의 생환
ko-KR.description: 호오, 서바이벌 모드 HELL 코스에 도전하시겠다? 지옥에서 돌아온 자가 있다면 이 Bison 님이 직접 상대해 주지.

en-US.name: Back From Hell
en-US.description: Feel like taking the plunge into Survival Mode on extreme? Come back alive, and I'll grant you an audience with none other than me, the great Lord Bison!

trophies.description: Feel like taking the plunge into Survival Mode on extreme? Come back alive, and I'll grant you an audience with none other than me, the great Lord Bison!

trophies.name: Priceless

ko-KR.name: 돈으로 매길 수 없는 가치
ko-KR.description: 지금까지 총 1,000,000FM을 획득했군요. 서민 치고는 나쁘지 않은 수준이네요. 하지만 그 진정한 가치는 Fight Money를 얻기 위해 지금껏 걸어 온 길에 있답니다.

en-US.name: Priceless
en-US.description: You managed to get 1,000,000 FM. That's pretty good! The real value, however, is in the path you walked to earn that much.

trophies.description: You managed to get 1,000,000 FM. That's pretty good! The real value, however, is in the path you walked to earn that much.

trophies.name: The outfit is the highlight of battle

ko-KR.name: 몸단장은 전투의 꽃이랍니다
ko-KR.description: 일류 격투가라면 관객의 눈을 즐겁게 할 줄도 알아야 하는 법. 자, 새로운 색상을 입수하세요.

en-US.name: The outfit is the highlight of battle
en-US.description: The true creme de la creme know how to give spectators a good show. Now go and gain new colors for your outfit.

trophies.description: The true creme de la creme know how to give spectators a good show. Now go and gain new colors for your outfit.

games.name: METAL GEAR SOLID V: GROUND ZEROES

trophies.name: Downfall

en-US.name: Downfall
en-US.description: Clear the "Ground Zeroes" mission

trophies.description: Clear the "Ground Zeroes" mission

trophies.name: Reunion
